senses.gloss: सर्व-दान- + अधिक सर्व-दान- + अधिक, adj. better than any gift, Yājñ. 1, 334.
स- + अर्क स- + अर्क, adj. with the sun, sunny.
स- + अर्चि स- + अर्चि, adj. flaming, Rām. 4, 10, 20.
शरण- + अर्थिन् शरण- + अर्थिन्, adj. depending on others for protection, unfortunate.
सर्वावसर + म् सर्वावसर + म्, i. e. सर्व-, adv. on every occasion, Lass. 2, 2.
शर- + असन शर- + असन, n. a bow.

शरासन शरासन, i. e. शर-असन, n.
 1. Shooting arrows.
 2. A bow, Vikr. d. 70.
सारसन सारसन, i. e. स-रसन + अ, n. A girdle, Kir. 18, 32.
शर- + आक्षेप शर- + आक्षेप, m. a flight of arrows.
शर- + आघात शर- + आघात, m. shooting with a bow.
स- + आरोह स- + आरोह, adj., f. हा, rising, Rām. 5, 73, 6.
स- + आर्द्र स- + आर्द्र, adj. Wet.
शर- + आवाप शर- + आवाप, m. a bow, MBh. 1, 7073.
शर- + इषीका शर- + इषीका, f. an arrow, Rām. 2, 104, 43, Gorr.
शर- + उत्तम शर- + उत्तम, m. a very good arrow, Rām. 3, 50, 16.
सर्व-भूत-हित- + एषिन् सर्व-भूत-हित- + एषिन्, adj. wishing the well-being of all creatures, Chr. 26, 64.
शर- + ओघ शर- + ओघ, m. a multitude of arrows, Chr. 34, 15.
सर्व- + ओघ सर्व- + ओघ, m. 1. assembling a complete army. 2. great speed.
शरीर- + कर्तृ शरीर- + कर्तृ, m. a father, Chr. 15, 28.
सर्व- + कामगम सर्व- + कामगम, yielding every desired object, MBh. 13, 357.
सर्व- + कामिन् सर्व- + कामिन्, i. e. सर्वकाम + इन्, adj. abounding in all pleasures, Sund. 1, 31 (v. r.).
सर्व-काम्य सर्व-काम्य, adj. deserving to be wished for by every one, Sund. 4, 7.
सर्वार्थ- + कुशल सर्वार्थ- + कुशल, i. e. सर्व-अर्थ-, adj. expert in all affairs, Nal. 8, 4.
सर्व-दुःख- + क्षय सर्व-दुःख- + क्षय, m. final emancipation.
सर्व- + गम् सर्व- + गम्, adj. omnipresent.
शरच्चन्द्र शरच्चन्द्र, i. e. शरद्-, m. the autumnal moon.
सर्वार्थ- + चिन्तक सर्वार्थ- + चिन्तक, i. e. सर्व-अर्थ-, m. a superintendent of all affairs, Man. 7, 121.
शर- + जन्मन् शर- + जन्मन्, m. Kārtikeya, the god of war.
सरोजन्मन् सरोज्˚, i. e. सरस्-, n. a lotus.
सर्व- + ज्ञ सर्व- + ज्ञ, adj. omniscient, Bhartṛ. 2, 8.

सर्वज्ञ सर्व-ज्ञ,
 I. adj. Omniscient, Hit. 129, 9; Bhartṛ. 2, 8.
 II. m. Śiva.
 --Comp.
शरीर- + तुल्य शरीर- + तुल्य, adj. dear as one's person.
सर्व- + तेजोमय सर्व- + तेजोमय, adj. containing every kind of power, Man. 7, 11.
सर्वतेजोमय सर्वतेजोमय, i. e. सर्व-तेजस् + मय, adj., f. यी, Containing every splendour, Man. 7, 11.

सर्व- + दमन सर्व- + दमन,
 I. adj. all-subduing.
 II. m. Bharata, the son of Śakuntalā.
शर्वरी- + दीपक शर्वरी- + दीपक, m. the lamp of the night (epithet of the moon), Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2968.
शार्ङ्ग- + पाणि शार्ङ्ग- + पाणि, m. Viṣṇu, Megh. 109.
स-रथ- + पादात स-रथ- + पादात, adj. with chariots and infantry.
सर्व- + प्रिय सर्व- + प्रिय, adj. 1. generally beloved. 2. generally friendly, loving all.
शारि- + फल शारि- + फल, n. a chequered cloth or fable for playing draughts.
सर्व- + भक्ष्य सर्व- + भक्ष्य, adj. 1. eating anything (a child). 2. omnivorous. Desider. of i. 10, बिभक्षयिष, To desire to devour, MBh. 1, 5951.

सर्व- + भक्ष सर्व- + भक्ष,
 I. adj. omnivorous, eating all things, Hit. ii. d. 173.
 II. f. षा, a female goat.

सार- + भङ्ग सार- + भङ्ग,
 I. adj. void of pith, substance, strength.
 II. m. destroying vigour.

सर्वतोभद्र सर्वतोभ्˚, i. e. सर्वतस्-, []
 I. adj. everywhere auspicious.
 II. m. and n. a temple or palace of a square form, with an entrance opposite to each point of the compass.
 III. m. 1. the carriage of Viṣṇu. 2. a form of military array. 3. a bambu. 4. the Nimb tree.
 IV. f. द्रा. 1. an actress. 2. the name of two plants.
सार- + भाण्ड सार- + भाण्ड, n. 1. a natural vessel, as the bag or skin in which musk is sold. 2. a bale of goods, Pañc. 8, 14. 3. implements, Mālav. 44, 1 (Prākṛ.)
सर्व- + भाव सर्व- + भाव, m. one's whole being, Hit. ii. d. 33.
सर्व- + मङ्गल सर्व- + मङ्गल, f. ला, Durgā, Hit. 99, 8.
सर्प- + मणि सर्प- + मणि, m. the snake-stone, or carbuncle, a jewel said to be found in the head of a snake.
सर्व-क्षत्रिय- + मर्दन सर्व-क्षत्रिय- + मर्दन, m. the destroyer of all the military class, Johns. Sel. 3, 16.
शरीर- + मात्र शरीर- + मात्र, n. the mere person, body only.

सर्वतोमुख सर्वतोमुख, i. e. सर्वतस्-,
 I. adj., f. खी. 1. facing every quarter, i. e. to every quarter (of the world), Sund. 2, 13. 2. complete, unrestrained, Śāk. d. 122.
 II. m. 1. Brahman. 2. a Brāhmaṇa. 3. soul, spirit. 4. paradise.
 III. n. 1. sky. 2. water.
सार- + योग सार- + योग, m. possession or application of the essence of any thing, Kir. 5, 52.
स- + रजस् स- + रजस्, f. a woman during menstruation.
स- + रथ स- + रथ, adj. with the carriage.
स-रभस + म् स-रभस + म्} adv. 1. quickly Utt. Rāmac. 144, 11. 2. passionate Lass. 24, 15.
शार्ङ्ग- + रव शार्ङ्ग- + रव, m. a proper name.
स- + रस स- + रस, see s. v.

सरस सरस, i. e. सरस् + अ, and स-रस,
 I. n.
 1. A pond.
 2. (or m. ?), Alchemy, Rājat. 4, 247.
 3. A substitute for सरस् at the end of some comp. words.
 II. adj.
 1. Tasty, juicy, Megh. 14.
 2. Beautiful, charming, Mālat. 51, 5; Bhartṛ. 1, 6; agreeable, Ṛt. 1, 2.
 3. New, Śiś. 9, 85.
 4. Impassioned.
 5. ˚सम्, adv. Enraptured, Vikr. 57, 11.

सारस सारस, i. e. सरस् + अ,
 I. adj. Relating or belonging to a lake, Nalod. 2, 40.
 II. m., and f. सी, The Indian crane, male and female, Ardea sibirica, Rām. 3, 53, 58; Pañc. 82, 6; ii. d. 103 (cf. my transl.); a bird in general, Nalod. 2, 10.
 III. m. The moon.
 IV. n. A lotus, Caurap. 44.
 --Comp.
स- + रहस्य स- + रहस्य, adj. magical (as weapons), Utt. Rāmac. 11, 3.
स- + राग स- + राग, adj. 1. coloured. 2. impassioned.
स- + राजक स- + राजक, adj. together with the king, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 519.
स- + राहु स- + राहु, adj. seized by Rāhu, i. e. eclipsed, Bhāg. P. 3, 17, 8.
स-रुज स-रुज, adj. sick, Sāv. 5, 79.
स-रुष् स-रुष्, adj. angry, Pañc. i. d. 80 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3196).
स- + रूप स- + रूप, adj. like, resembling.
स- + रोग स- + रोग, adj. sick.
स- + रोष स- + रोष, adj. angry, Śiś. 9, 83. षम्, adv. angrily, Vikr. 55, 7.
सार- + लोह सार- + लोह, n. steel.
सर्व- + लोहमय सर्व- + लोहमय, adj. entirely of iron, Pañc. 122, 10.
सरोवर सरोवर, i. e. सरस्-, m. a lake.
सरित्- + वर सरित्- + वर, f. रा, the Gaṅgā.
शर- + वर्ष शर- + वर्ष, m. a shower of arrows, Chr. 4, 20.
सार्थ- + वाह सार्थ- + वाह, m. 1. the leader of a caravan, Pañc. 9, 1. 2. a great merchant, [] Mṛcch. 2, 3. 3. a merchant.
स-रोमविक्रिय स-रोमविक्रिय, i. e. स-रोमन्-, adj. affected with horripilation (as a sign of excessive pleasure), Vikr. d. 12.
सर्व-धर्म- + विद् सर्व-धर्म- + विद्, adj. one who knows the whole of duty, Man. 8, 63.
सर्व- + वेदस् सर्व- + वेदस्, m. a man who, at the conclusion of the विश्वजित् sacrifice, divides all his property amongst the priests.
सर्व- + वेशिन् सर्व- + वेशिन्, i. e. सर्ववेश + इन्, m. an actor, a dancer.

शर शर,
 I. m.
 1. A sort of reed, Saccharum sara, Man. 8, 247; a reed, Pañc. 140, 25.
 2. An arrow (i. e. शॄ + अ), Pañc. 224, 11.
 3. The cream of slightly curdled milk, Mālav. d. 43 (cream, cf. सर).
 II. n. Water.
 --Comp.

शार शार,
 I. adj.
 1. Variegated (in colour), Daśak. in Chr. 180, 1 (of hair, mixed with grey and white).
 2. Yellow.
 II. m.
 1. Hurting (vb. शॄ).
 2. A mixture of blue and yellow, a green.
 3. Variegating.
 4. Air, wind (cf. सार).
 5. A piece or man at chess, backgammon, [] Daśak. in Chr. 185, 24 (cf. सार).
 III. f. री.
 1. An arrow (vb. शॄ, cf. शर), Chr. 297, 16 = Rigv. i. 112, 16.
 2. Kuśa grass.
 --Comp.

सर सर, i. e. सृ + अ,
 I. adj. Who or what goes.
 II. m.
 1. Going.
 2. An arrow (? see शर).
 3. The coagulum of curds or milk.
 4. Salt, saltness.
 III. m., and f. रा or री, A waterfall.
 IV. n.
 1. Water.
 2. A pond, a lake, Pañc. 131, 15.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. serum; ὀρρός, ὀρός; Lat. sal; Goth. salt; A.S. sealt; ἅλς; Lat. salum, insula; ἔναλος; A.S. siringie.

सार सार, perhaps सृ + अ, with ‘cream,’
 II.
 9. as first signification,
 I. adj.
 1. Essential, Hit. iv. d. 71.
 2. Excellent, best, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 22; Pañc. i. d. 284; Hit. iii. d. 89.
 3. Hard, Śāk. d. 10.
 4. Irrefragable (as an argument), proved, Man. 9, 262.
 II. m. (and n.).
 1. The pith or sap of trees.
 2. The essence of anything, the essential or vital part of it, Hit. ii. d. 126; Pañc. 49, 4.
 3. Nectar, Bhāg. P. 7, 6, 25.
 4. The substance or material part (of a book, speech, etc.), Pañc. pr. d. 3; 10 (n.).
 5. Marrow, Ragh. 10, 10.
 6. Strength, vigour, Hit. 104, 7; affluence, Hit. i. d. 90, M.M. (अर्थ-, of wealth, cf.
 IV.
 2.).
 7. Prowess, heroism.
 8. Firmness, hardness.
 9. The coagulum of curds, cream.
 10. Fresh butter.
 11. Air, [] wind (cf. शार).
 12. Disease, pus, Hit. ii. d. 101 (and wealth).
 III. m., and f. री, A man at chess, backgammon (cf. शार).
 IV. n.
 1. Water.
 2. Wealth, Man. 8, 126; Daśak. in Chr. 189, 3 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 3. Fitness.
 4. Steel.
 5. (In rhetoric), Climax.
 V. f. रा, Kuśa grass.
 VI. f. री, Turdus Salica Buch.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. सर; Goth. sêls; A.S. sel, sael.
शरज शर-ज, n. Fresh butter.
सरज सर-ज, n. Fresh butter.
शरट शरट, see सरट.
सरट सरट, and शरट शरट, m. The gecko, Lacerta gecko, Man. 12, 57 (with स्).

शरण शरण, n.
 I. (akin to श्रि),
 1. [] A house, Pañc. i. d. 69; habitation, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 26.
 2. Refuge, Hit. i. d. 189, M.M.; protection, Pañc. 90, 5; 141, 11; 175, 12; help, Vikr. 19, 17; a protector.
 II. (vb. श्री + अन), Killing.
 --Comp.

सरण सरण, i. e. सृ + अन,
 I. adj. Who or what goes.
 II. n.
 1. Going.
 2. Oxidised iron.
 III. f. णा and णि, A plant, Pæderia fetida.
सारण सारण, i. e. सृ, Caus., + अन, m. Dysentery.

शरणि शरणि (akin to श्रि), f.
 1. A row, a line.
 2. A road, a path.

सरणि and णी सरणी̆, i. e. सृ + अन + ई, f.
 1. A path, a road.
 2. A straight or continuous line.
 3. A disease of the throat. Cf. the last.
सारणि and णी सारणी̆ i. e. सृ + अन + ई, f. A canal, a water-conduit.

शरण्य शरण्य, i. e. शरण + य,
 I. adj.
 1. Needing protection, Lass. 2. ed. 90, 50; helpless, poor, miserable.
 2. Yielding protection, helping, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 3; Sāv. 1, 2; Chr. 17, 25.
 II. n.
 1. A house.
 2. Refuge, protection, a protector.
 3. (i. e. शॄ + अन + य), Injury, hurt.

शरद् शरद्, and शरदा शरदा (probably from शॄ), f.
 1. The autumn, Pañc. v. d. 42 (रद्).
 2. A year, Utt. Rāmac. 11, 8 (रद्).
 --Comp.
शरदिज शरद् + इ-ज, adj. Produced in autumn, Utt. Rāmac. 3, 18.
शरद्वन्त् शरद् + वन्त्, m. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 59, 176.
शरधि शरधि, i. e. शर-धा (cf. निधि), m. A quiver, Vikr. d. 18.
शरन्मेघवत् शरन्मेघवत्, i. e. शरद्-मेघ + वत्, adv. Like clouds of autumn, Hit. d. 91.

शरभ शरभ (cf. करभ), m.
 1. A fabulous animal with eight legs, stronger than a lion, Megh. 55.
 2. A young elephant.
 3. A camel.
 4. A grasshopper (cf. शलभ).
 5. A locust, [] Ṛt. 1, 23.
 --Cf. perhaps κάραϐος; A.S. crabba.
शरमय शर + मय, adj., f. यी, Made or consisting of शर grass.
शरयु and यू शर + यू̆ (better सरयू̆, q. cf.), f. The name of a river.

सरयु सरयु (vb. सृ),
 I. m. Air, wind.
 II. f., also यू यू, The name of a river, Rām. 2, 49, 15 (यू).

शरल शरल (cf. सरल),
 I. adj.
 1. Upright, Pañc. iii. d. 69.
 2. Fraudulent(?).
 II. m. A sort of pine, Rām. 5, 17, 15.

सरल सरल (vb. सृ),
 I. adj.
 1. Straight, Pañc. ii. d. 189.
 2. Upright, honest, Mālat. 38, 1.
 II. m. A sort of pine, Pinus longifolia Roxb., Megh. 54.
शरवणोद्भव शरवणोद्भव, and शरवणभव शरवणभव, i. e. शर-वन-उद्-भू + अ, or -वन-भव, m. A name of the god of war, Megh. 46 (˚वणभ्˚).

शरवाणि शरवाणि, m.
 1. The head of an arrow.
 2. The maker of arrows.
 3. A foot-soldier (probably an anomal. derivation from शर + वन्).
शरव्य शर + व्य (or शरु + य?), n. A butt, a mark for arrows, Śāk. d. 156; aim, Ragh. 11, 27.
शराटि शराटि, शराडि शराडि, शराति शराति, शरारि शरारि, and शरालि शरालि, f. A bird, Turdus ginginianus.

सरटि सरटि, m.
 1. Wind.
 2. A cloud (cf. सरट्).
शराय शराय, a denomin. derived from शर with य, Ātm. To become an arrow, Śṛṅgārat. 13.
शरारि शरारि, शरालि शरालि, see शराटि.
शरारु शरारु (vb. शॄ), adj. Hurtful, mischievous.

शराव शराव, m. and n. (ŚKD.),
 1. A lid, a cover.
 2. A shallow cup or dish, Hit. 114, 22; Pañc. 174, 14; Man. 6, 56; a tray, Vikr. 45, 13; a [] vessel (figurat. निष्ठीवन-, A spitting box), Bhartṛ. 1, 91.
 3. A measure equal to two कुडवस्.
 --Comp.
शरि शरि, i. e. शॄ + ई, adj. Hurtful.

शारि शारि (cf. शार),
 I. m.
 1. A piece or man at chess, draughts, etc.
 2. An elephant's housings.
 3. Fraud.
 II. m., f. रि or री, A bird, Gracula religiosa.
सरि सरि, i. e. सृ + इ, f. A waterfall.
शरिमन् and शरीमन् शरी̆मन्, m. Bringing forth.
सरिमन् and सरीमन् सरी̆मन् (vb. सृ), m. Wind.

शरीर शरीर (vb. शॄ), n.
 1. The body, Pañc. iii. d. 96.
 2. Life, Hit. iii. d. 103.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. perhaps A.S. hold, cadaver.

शारीर शारीर, i. e. शरीर + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Corporeal, Bhag. 17, 14; relating to animal bodies, Man. 5, 110.
 2. Spiritual, incorporate.
 II. n.
 1. Excrement, Man. 11, 202.
 2. The soul whilst incorporate.

शरीरज शरीर-ज,
 I. adj. Produced by the body.
 II. m.
 1. A son.
 2. Disease.
 3. Kāma.

शरीरिन् शरीरिन्, i. e. शरीर + इन्,
 I. adj., f. रिणी.
 1. Embodied, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 12.
 2. Living, Chr. 20, 20 (नहि वाणा मयोत्सृष्टाः सज्जन्ति शरीरिणां कायेषु, For the arrows which I have shot do not stick in the bodies of living beings, i. e. all
 I. hit with my arrows must die).
 II. m.
 1. A sentient being, Rājat. 5, 20; Pañc. iii. d. 90; a man, Pañc. ii. d. 107.
 2. An embodied spirit, Man. 1, 53; 6, 64.
 3. The soul, Bhag. 2, 18; Bhāṣāp. 26.
 --Comp.

शरु शरु, i. e. शॄ + उ (or rather शर् + वन्, cf. κεραυν + ός), m.
 1. An arrow.
 2. The thunderbolt of Indra.
 3. Any weapon.
 4. Passion, anger.
 --Cf. Goth. hairus.

शर्करा शर्करा (probably from vb. शॄ, but cf. कर्कर), f.
 1. A potsherd.
 2. Gravel.
 3. Stone, Rājat. 5, 432.
 4. A part.
 5. A soil abounding in stony fragments.
 6. Clayed or candied sugar, Pañc. i. d. 423; 185, 21; Lass. 79, 16.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. calculus, calx; κρόκη, κροκάλη, κάχληξ, etc.

शार्कर शार्कर, i. e. शर्करा + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Stony.
 2. Sugary.
 II. m. The froth of milk, cream.
शर्करावन्त् शर्करा + वन्त्, and शर्करिल शर्करिल, i. e. शर्करा + इल, adj., f. वती, ला, Full of stony particles.

शर्ध शर्ध, i. e. शृध् + अ, m.
 1. A fart.
 2. A troop, Chr. 290, 1 = Rigv. 2, 64, 1.
शर्धंजह शर्धंजह, i. e. शर्ध + म्-जह (the latter is a mutilation of जहत्, the ptcple. pres. of हा), m. Any leguminous pulse (causing flatulence), as beans.

† शर्ब् शर्ब्, i. 1, Par.
 I. To kill.
 II. and शम्ब् शम्ब्, To go (cf. शर्व्).
† सर्ब् सर्ब्, सम्ब् सम्ब्, i. 1, Par. To go.

शर्मन् शर्मन् (vb. श्रि, cf. शरण), n.

सार्धम् सार्धम्, i. e. स-अर्ध + म्, prep. (with instr.), With, Man. 1, 27; Pañc. i. d. 61; iii. d. 74.
सार्पिष सार्पिष, and सार्पिष्क सार्पिष्क, i. e. सर्पिस् + अ, or क, adj. Dressed with clarified butter.
सार्पी सार्पी, see the next.

सार्प्य सार्प्य, i. e. सर्प + य,
 I. adj. Relating to a snake.
 II. f. पी, The ninth lunar mansion.
सार्वकामिक सार्वकामिक, i. e. सर्व-काम + इक, adj. Satisfying every wish, Kir. 18, 25.
सार्वकालिक सार्वकालिक, i. e. सर्व-काल + इक, adj., f. की, Of all times or seasons, everlasting, MBh. 1, 7648.
सार्वजनिक सार्वजनिक, and सार्वजनीन सार्वजनीन, i. e. सर्व-जन + इक, or ईन, adj. Relating, or belonging, or suited, to all men.
सार्वदैवत्य सार्वदैवत्य, i. e. सर्व-देवत + य, adj. Presided over by, or sacred to, all the gods.

सार्वभौतिक सार्वभौतिक, i. e. सर्व-भूत + इक, adj.
 1. Belonging or relating to all elements, beings.
 2. Comprising all animated beings, Man. 12, 51.

सार्वभौम सार्वभौम, i. e. सर्व-भूमि + अ,
 I. adj. Relating to, or consisting of, the whole earth.
 II. m.
 1. An universal monarch.
 2. The elephant of the northern quarter.
 3. A proper name, Bhāg. P. 9, 22, 10.
सार्वलौकिक सार्वलौकिक, i. e. सर्व-लोक + इक, adj. Prevailing through the universe, Mālat. 7, 5.

सार्ववर्णिक सार्ववर्णिक, i. e. सर्व-वर्ण + इक, adj.
 1. Of every kind, Man. 2, 244.
 2. Belonging to every tribe.
सार्ववेदस सार्ववेदस, i. e. सर्व-वेदस् + अ, m. One who gives away all his wealth at a sacred rite, Man. 11, 1.
सार्ववेद्य सार्ववेद्य, i. e. सर्व-वेद + य, [] m. A Brāhmaṇa conversant with all the Vedas.
सार्ष्टिता सार्ष्टिता, perhaps स-ऋष् + ति + ता, f. Equality, Man. 4, 232.
शारीरक- + सूत्र शारीरक- + सूत्र, n. statement concerning the embodied spirit, i. e. the ब्रह्मसूत्रस् of Bādarāyaṇa, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 7.
शर- + स्तम्ब शर- + स्तम्ब, m. a clump of reeds, Pañc. 140, 25.
सर्व- + स्व सर्व- + स्व, n. 1. the whole property, Pañc. iii. d. 132. 2. the whole essence of anything, Pañc. 111, 6; iii. d. 104.
सर्व-पाप- + हर सर्व-पाप- + हर, adj. removing, or the remover of, all sin.
सर्व-स्व- + हार सर्व-स्व- + हार, m. seizure or confiscation of all one's property, Man. 9, 242; 8, 399.
